Georgia: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Georgia on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 5, 2026. Last day to register or update your registration for the November 3 general election.
  • In-person early (advance) voting: October 13, 2026 to October 30, 2026. Early voting includes two Saturdays. Counties may also offer Sunday voting. You can vote at any early voting site in your county.
  • Last day to request an absentee-by-mail ballot: October 23, 2026. Requests opened August 17.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls in Georgia are normally open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time, but no page checked for this request stated the hours. If no candidate gets a majority, there is a runoff on December 1, 2026.

Official election information: Georgia Secretary of State – Elections Division

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

Federal

United States Senate

One seat with a six-year term. Democratic incumbent Jon Ossoff is running for a second term, and a runoff is held on December 1 if no candidate wins a majority.
